title: Salt in water
hook: Water and salt. *How much* decides the job.

dishes.name: Pasta water
dishes.text: About *10 g per litre*: the pasta soaks it up and comes out seasoned.

dishes.name: Pickle brine
dishes.text: *Five times more*: cucumbers ferment sour and crunchy, and spoilers stay out.

sources: https://www.americastestkitchen.com/articles/5840-how-salty-should-your-pasta-water-be (ATK: 1 Tbsp table salt per 4 qt water ≈ 0.5%)
https://spokesman.com/stories/2023/may/10/how-to-salt-pasta-water-its-as-much-art-as-science (Serious Eats test: 0.5–2% salt by weight acceptable; 1% is the middle)
https://nwedible.com/how-much-salt-fermentation/ (5% brine, 50 g salt per litre, for cucumber pickles)
